label: AGENT REVIEW — AUTHORISED BY OWNER
method: Live: Story Bible generated on the synthetic 40-chapter story (isolated test stack :8100, narratiq_test) after the three generation fixes; final run read in full and every doubtful statement checked against the imported chapter text (grep with both straight and curly apostrophes) and backend/tests/fixtures/long_manuscript_spec.py. Note: the chapter prose was model-written from the beats and is itself inconsistent in places (e.g. Liesel is a baker in Ch 6 and a fishmonger in Ch 10; Silas calls Wren's aunt 'my aunt' in Ch 16) — statements were judged against the PROSE, not the beats. CAVEAT: chapter 40 had been emptied at 11:35 by the undo data-loss defect found in HR-15/HR-17 (fixed, chapter restored) before the final bible runs; the bible still drew Ch 40 facts from the stored chapter summaries. Ch 40 omissions are not counted against the bible.

HR-10.Q1.note: Silas 'Businessman' (customs officer, Ch 5); Ferris 'Chandlery Owner'; Ferris arc = Wren's resolve; 'Eliza Thorne — Wren's aunt, Edric's wife' (no Thorne surname or marriage anywhere); her arc = Wren's actions; Mrs Blackwood arc = Wren's Ch 26 decision; Ada arc = Wren's feeling; Liesel 'supportive / support Wren' though she poisons Thorne (Ch 31); Sheriff O'Connor and Captain Harlow tagged Ch 21 (they appear in Ch 18).

HR-10.Q2.note: Tobin 'Lighthouse Keeper' and goal 'clear his name'; Mayor 'ambitious, cautious, protective'; Edric goal 'uncover discrepancies'. Also: most card lines carry no [Ch N] tag.

HR-10.Q3.note: Liesel as poisoner/antagonist; Edric Thorne's death; Tobin's confession (Ch 22) and testimony (Ch 39); Mother Agathe absent.

HR-10.Q4.note: Harbour Wall chase [Ch 28] (chase is in the alleys); 'Thorne's Home' where Wren tends him (Ada nursed him, Ch 13); fishmonger's meeting tagged Ch 33 with Liesel hinting (a recollection in Ch 31); body 'in the salt marsh' (beach/shingle, Ch 21); 'Thorne House' [Ch 31] (she stands at the salt marsh); 'General Store — not explicitly mentioned [Ch 33]' (it is, Ch 31).

HR-10.Q5.note: Lighthouse 'work together to get it operational' (nowhere); Town Square 'start of the investigation into business matters'; rope-works 'linked to smuggling and industrial activities'.

HR-10.Q6.note: Anchor Inn (cellar, tunnel, locked room, the truth scene); harbour chapel; customs house; the Marisol wreck site.

HR-10.Q7.note: 'Tobin admits to buying lamp oil on credit [Ch 11]' — the storekeeper Arthur says it.

HR-10.Q8.note: 'Wren visits the lighthouse to confront Tobin' and 'work together to get the lighthouse operational' [Ch 11] — neither is in the text.

HR-10.Q9.note: Thorne's poisoning/death as an event; Ferris's 'I am your father' (Ch 38); the trap (Ch 37) and the truth and arrests (Ch 39); Ada's falling-out and reconciliation (Ch 23/26). (The Ch 40 ledger burial is not counted: chapter 40 was empty in the database when these runs were generated — see caveat.)

HR-10.Q10.note: 'Wren's health is a concern [Ch 13]' (Thorne was ill); Liesel's poisoning cited to Ch 33 (it is Ch 31).

HR-10.Q11.note: Discrepancies 'must be addressed to avoid legal consequences'; 'the community values honesty'; 'storms are common occurrences'; 'Tobin's involvement in disappearances' (he denies it).

HR-10.Q12.note: Smuggling and customs law ('would hang', Ch 16); wrecking by darkening the lighthouse (Ch 22).

HR-10.Q15.note: Betrayal / complicity and secret-keeping; identity and paternity.

HR-10.Q16.note: Wrong facts about main characters: Liesel (the poisoner) presented as supportive; Wren's aunt given an invented surname and a marriage to Edric Thorne. No wholly invented character: every name checked occurs in the prose.

HR-10.Q17.value: See Q1–Q14 notes. Corrections to my own first pass after checking the text: 'Sheriff O'Connor', 'Mr. and Mrs. Green', the Devil's Cleft and the pirate ARE in the prose (curly apostrophes), so they are not counted.

result_reasoning: FAIL: 30 wrong or unsupported statements across the five sections (characters 14, locations 9, timeline 3, world rules 6, themes 1), including wrong facts about main characters (UAT Q3 rule: a High finding). The criterion 'never asserts unsupported facts' is not met. Three generation defects found during the live review were fixed (timeline truncated at 1,500 tokens; characters section truncated in 6/8 samples; a looping 'Also appears' list) — after the fixes two full regenerations completed with all five sections. The content-accuracy failure is a model-quality limit and stays open.
